sources.note: An online bandit controller that jointly decides which model to route a query to and how much test-time compute to spend, to optimize the quality-cost tradeoff.
sources.title: UniScale: Adaptive Unified Inference Scaling via Online Joint Optimization of Model Routing and Test-Time Scaling

sources.note: Optimizes the sequence of injected noise vectors during diffusion model denoising, using an epsilon-greedy search cast as sequential contextual bandits, to improve image generation quality at fixed or extra test-time compute.
sources.title: Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models via Noise Trajectory Search

result.definition: An online-learning framework for repeatedly choosing an action (e.g. which model to route a query to, or how much test-time compute to spend) based on context, using observed rewards to improve the choice over time. UniScale uses a bandit controller (LinUCB) to jointly decide model routing and test-time-compute allocation per query; the diffusion-model noise-trajectory-search paper casts its epsilon-greedy noise search the same way -- though that application is unrelated to LLM reasoning length.
